notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-2). Quota exhaustion mid-session: turn 1 on Kolibri, a model switch to a mock provider that refuses every request with HTTP 403 insufficient_quota, turn 2 refused. The refused turn ends in error and the session stays there — no stuck working, no waiting. No working phase is pinned for the refused turn: it is over within milliseconds.

transcript_assertions.name: the quota refusal ended a turn

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — an API session is first seen working (P4; P5a's smoke cells)
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
Turn 1 (on Kolibri) drives the session to working
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded ends turn 1 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The plugin's session.execution.failed ends the refused turn 2 (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The quota refusal ends turn 2 in error, and the session stays there — never ready or waiting again (unbounded: no later turn)
